title: Selected Work
subtitle: Real systems. Real results. Here's what we've built and what it did.

items.title: Missed Call Text-Back System
items.summary: When a call goes unanswered, an SMS fires within 60 seconds; apologizing, offering a booking link, and inviting a reply. Leads that would have called the next salon book with you instead.

items.title: No-Show Recovery Automation
items.summary: No-show? An immediate text goes out. Another follows the next day. A rebook offer fires on day 3. A discount kicks in on day 7 if they still haven't booked. Recovers 20-30% of clients you'd otherwise lose for good.

items.title: Automated Review Request System
items.summary: Two hours after every appointment, a text goes out with a direct Google review link. No response in 48 hours? A follow-up fires automatically. Salons using this see 3-5x more reviews than asking in person.

items.title: Appointment Reminder Sequence
items.summary: Clients get a reminder 48 hours out and again 2 hours before. They confirm or cancel with one tap. Cancellations trigger an instant rebook offer, and notify the stylist to fill the slot before it's wasted.

items.title: Win-Back Campaign for Inactive Clients
items.summary: Any client who hasn't booked in 60 days gets a personalized text: a we-miss-you message and a 15% off offer with a direct booking link. Runs every month on autopilot. Zero manual work.

items.title: AI Receptionist — Inbound Call Handling
items.summary: AI answers every call 24/7: handles pricing questions, checks availability, books appointments directly into the system, and texts a confirmation. Trained on your exact services and staff. You never miss a booking again.

items.title: New Client Welcome Sequence
items.summary: First-time booking? A 3-message sequence runs automatically over 7 days: a warm welcome, pre-appointment tips, and a post-visit check-in that asks for a review. Turns one-time visitors into regulars.

items.title: Instagram DM Auto-Response for Bookings
items.summary: Someone DMs asking about pricing or availability? AI replies instantly with the right info and a booking link, at any hour. Converts social media interest into booked appointments instead of ignored messages.

items.title: Speed-to-Lead AI Response System
items.summary: New Zillow lead? An AI SMS fires in under 60 seconds, referencing the exact property, asking about pre-approval and timeline, and routing serious buyers directly to you. Leads contacted in under 5 minutes are 21x more likely to convert.

items.title: Cold Lead Re-Engagement Sequence
items.summary: Lead went quiet? A 6-touch sequence runs over 30 days: market updates, new listings matching their criteria, price drop alerts. Personalized. Automated. Agents consistently re-engage 30-50% of leads they'd written off.

items.title: AI Lead Qualification Chatbot
items.summary: Website chatbot qualifies every lead 24/7: budget, location, timeline, financing. Scores them hot, warm, or cold. Alerts the agent only for serious buyers. Syncs everything to the CRM automatically. Saves 5+ hours a week on manual qualification.
outcomes: Only serious leads reach the agent

items.title: Post-Showing Follow-Up Automation
items.summary: Right after every showing, a text goes out: thank you, any questions, ready to offer? Silence for 48 hours? A follow-up fires with a quick market comparison. Keeps momentum without the agent having to chase.
outcomes: No lead left without a follow-up

items.title: CRM Auto-Population from Lead Sources
items.summary: Every lead from Zillow, Realtor.com, Instagram, or referrals creates a CRM contact automatically. Tagged by source, assigned a follow-up sequence, and flagged to the agent. Manual data entry drops to zero.
outcomes: No lead falls through the cracks

items.title: AI Voice Agent for Inbound Inquiries
items.summary: AI answers inbound calls 24/7 and qualifies on budget, timeline, and pre-approval, books a callback, and texts a confirmation. By the time the agent speaks to a lead, they already know they're serious.
outcomes: Pre-qualified leads only reach the agent

items.title: Listing Alert Automation for Buyer Leads
items.summary: New listing matches a buyer's criteria? A personalized SMS fires within minutes with the address, specs, price, and a showing request link. The agent who responds first wins, this makes sure that's always you.

items.title: Referral Request Automation
items.summary: 30 days after every closing, a personalized congratulations message goes out, and asks if they know anyone buying or selling. Runs for every deal automatically. Turns happy clients into a steady referral source without lifting a finger.

items.title: AI Chatbot for Website FAQ
items.summary: Trained on your actual services, pricing, and policies. Answers questions 24/7, captures lead contact info, and escalates to a human when needed. Visitors get answers instantly, and you wake up to qualified leads in your inbox.

items.title: Google Review Response Automation
items.summary: Every new Google review: 5 stars or 1 star, gets an AI-drafted response written in your voice. You approve it, then it posts. Your profile stays active and engaged without spending 20 minutes a week on copy.

items.title: WhatsApp Business Automation
items.summary: Auto-responds to WhatsApp enquiries, sends appointment confirmations, shares menus or listings, and follows up after every interaction. Built specifically for the UK market where WhatsApp is how clients actually communicate.
